display_name: Ternary Bonsai on CPU (PrismML llama.cpp build, PQ2_0)

support.note: x86_64 CPU; the PrismML build carries every ggml CPU variant (AVX through AVX-512) and picks one at start

notes: The ternary engine the fleet runs as the `bonsai-cpu-t440` seat: PrismML's llama.cpp fork (catalogue ids bonsai, bonsaicpu), PQ2_0 ternary GGUFs, no GPU.
`llama-server` must be that build on lemond's PATH (the catalogue's llama-prism-b10822-bf8c069 folder, or the fleet's /mnt/fast/prism-bonsai/bin).
Measured 2026-11-10 on t440 with Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-PQ2_0.gguf; see CONFORMANCE.md.
